_comment: OPTIONAL add-on (fleet-ops#56), not applied anywhere. Merge this rule object into a repo's default-branch ruleset 'rules' array. Prereqs: (1) every required check's workflow must also trigger on `merge_group` (add `merge_group:` next to `pull_request:`), else queued PRs wait forever; (2) plan: GitHub merge queue on PRIVATE repos needs Enterprise Cloud - YPGOC is on the Team plan, so this works today only on public repos. Check the repo's Settings > Rules before applying; do not buy a plan for it. (3) Squash only, so keep allowed_merge_methods [squash] in the pull_request rule. Tail-green: a train's DONE needs CI green on the FINAL combined head (the commit the queue merges), not on each PR's own head - see CONTRIBUTING 'Merge trains'.
